description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy -  Order to require the Director General of Customs to demand and levy on each article from 11th July, 2018, for Import Duty at the general rate
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the publication of a Revenue Protection Order under the Revenue Protection Act, No. 19 of 1962, which establishes new customs duty rates and regulations for imported goods. It constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement for import duties, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
